title: Wall Mount Glass Shelf 16-Inch Triple Tier with Integrated Towel Bar (Solid Brass Hardware) Allied Brass
body_html:
Add refined, space-saving storage to your bath with a wall mount glass shelf featuring three tiers and an integrated towel bar in a traditional bathroom hardware style.

  • Triple-tier organization: three glass shelves keep daily essentials neat and accessible
  • Integrated towel bar: adds convenient hanging space for hand towels
  • Tempered glass strength: made with 3/8-inch thick tempered, beveled-edge glass
  • Solid brass hardware: crafted from the finest solid brass materials
  • Clean wall-mounted look: concealed screw mounting hardware

Specs

  • Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 inches
  • Overall size: 16-inch L x 5-inch W x 18-inch H
  • Weight capacity: 6 lb
  • Mounting: Wall mount
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware
  • Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4-inch
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Available in multiple designer finishes, including statement colors, to coordinate with classic bath accessories and heritage bathroom fixtures throughout your space.

_previous.description: Add space and organization to your bathroom with this simple, contemporary style glass shelf. Featuring tempered, beveled-edged glass and solid brass hardware this shelf is crafted for durability, strength and style. Integrated towel bar provides space for your favorite decorative towels or for your everyday use. One of the many coordinating accessories in the Allied Brass Collection of products, this subtle glass shelf is the perfect complement to your bathroom decor.
